summary: Dirt pull-off beside Witton Road backing onto bush, with no homes nearby.
reasons: Wide dirt verge off the lane
Backs onto bush and creek bank

best_section.where: Bare dirt pull-off on the north side of Witton Road, just east of the roundabout

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush and creek bank behind. No buildings mapped near; the car park to the east is across trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt pull-off meets the road edge and is wide enough for a van; two cars sit on it in the QLD image.
drivers.traffic: Busy Witton Road passes alongside; traffic is a flag, not a drawback, as the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Two cars parked on the pull-off in QLD (2022), none in Esri (2025); the wider car park next door is busy with parked cars.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 15 m from the kerb line, arrow Right; check it does not cover the pull-off
Low-lying: 3.4 m, Witton Creek 18 m away, flood-prone
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the north and east; open to the south.
cannot_judge: Whether the dirt is firm when wet
